# Psalm 144 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. Blessed YHWH my-rock, the-one-training my-hands for-battle, my-fingers for-war.

**2** My-steadfast-love and-my-fortress, my-stronghold and-my-deliverer, my-shield and-in-him I-take-refuge, the-one-subduing my-people under-me.

**3** O-YHWH what is-man that-you-know-him, son-of-man that-you-think-of-him?

**4** Man to-a-breath is-like; his-days like-a-shadow passing.

**5** O-YHWH bow your-heavens and-come-down; touch the-mountains and-they-will-smoke.

**6** Flash lightning and-scatter-them; send your-arrows and-confuse-them.

**7** Send your-hands from-on-high; rescue-me and-deliver-me from-waters many, from-hand-of sons-of foreignness,

**8** Whose mouth speaks vanity, and-their-right-hand a-right-hand-of falsehood.

**9** O-God a-song new I-will-sing to-you; on-a-harp-of-ten-strings I-will-sing-praises to-you,

**10** The-one-giving salvation to-kings, the-one-rescuing David his-servant from-sword evil.

**11** Rescue-me and-deliver-me from-hand-of sons-of foreignness, whose mouth speaks vanity, and-their-right-hand a-right-hand-of falsehood.

**12** That our-sons like-plants grown in-their-youth, our-daughters like-corner-pillars carved in-pattern-of a-palace.

**13** Our-storehouses full providing from-kind to-kind; our-flocks multiplying by-thousands, by-ten-thousands in-our-fields.

**14** Our-cattle heavy-laden; there-is-no breach and-no going-out, and-no outcry in-our-streets.

**15** Blessed the-people that-thus to-them; blessed the-people whose-God YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **144:3-4**: Echoes Psalm 8:4 — 'what is man?' — but here the answer emphasizes fragility (breath, passing shadow) rather than dignity.

- **144:12-15**: A vision of comprehensive shalom: strong children, full storehouses, abundant flocks, secure walls, peaceful streets.

— EMET
